name: Dumbbell Step-Up
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your chest tall.
Place your entire working foot firmly on top of the box.
Drive through the heel and midfoot of your elevated leg to lift your body straight up until that hip and knee are fully extended.
Lower your trailing foot slowly back to the floor under control, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Push through the foot on the box and keep the push from the trailing foot small.
Keep your front knee aligned over your toes rather than letting it cave inward.
